q: The Ghys theorem on actions of higher-rank lattices on the circle S¹: for any action Γ → Homeo(S¹) of a lattice Γ in a higher-rank semisimple Lie group:
opts: The action is always by isometries
The action factors through a finite group (has finite image)
The action is conjugate to a rotation action
exp: Ghys (1999) and Burger-Monod (2002) proved (by different methods) that any action of a higher-rank lattice on S¹ factors through a finite group. This is the Zimmer conjecture in dimension 1, confirming that higher-rank lattices cannot act faithfully on S¹.
